items.title: Honeywell Aerospace (HONA) Is Building A $500 Million Tempe Manufacturing Expansion
items.summary: Honeywell Aerospace (NasdaqGS:HONA) announced a US$500 million manufacturing expansion in Tempe, Arizona, aimed at internal production capacity and key aerospace customers. The Tempe build-out is expected to create new advanced manufacturing jobs and support both commercial and defense aviation programs.
